description: System-wide ad blocker, tracker filter and privacy guard for Windows
notes: The vendor ships a WiX/Burn bundle that installs a per-machine MSI plus a Windows service and a network driver. This manifest performs an administrative install of the bundled MSI instead, so the files land in the Scoop directory and nothing is registered on the system.

Because the AdGuard service and its driver are not installed, the filtering engine cannot intercept traffic: the interface runs, but protection stays inactive until you run the official installer with administrator rights.

AdGuard's own update checker and its 'start with Windows' option are driven by that service, so in this layout neither an update task nor a startup entry is created. The 'Adguard.exe' binary is shipped as-is; do not expect the in-app updater to work here.
pre_install: if ($offset -lt 0) { throw 'Attached installer container (CAB) not found inside the AdGuard bundle.' }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -gt 1) { throw "Failed to unpack the AdGuard payload (7z exit code $LASTEXITCODE)." }
if (!(Test-Path $package)) { throw 'Bundled AdGuard MSI (a1) not found in the attached container.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Administrative install of the AdGuard MSI failed (msiexec exit code $($process.ExitCode))." }
if ($null -eq $tree) { throw 'Adguard.exe not found in the administrative install output.' }
